trip.title: Oxnard
trip.subtitle: California Beach Weekend
trip.intro: Sixty miles northwest of Los Angeles, the seaside city of Oxnard sits where the Santa Clara River meets the Pacific — a working port town with wide sandy beaches and a vibrant harbor full of seals and sailboats.
highlights: Kentfield travelers: depart through the Marin hills, fuel up at the famed Patterson Starbucks on I-5, and let the highway carry you south to the Los Angeles Basin
Los Angeles travelers: depart Northridge via the Harbour Freight Parking Lot Starbucks  and head west on US-101 to the Oxnard coast
Afternoon surf lessons at Ventura Beach Surfschool
Kayak the calm channels of Channel Islands Harbor alongside harbor seals and sea lions
Beachside breakfast at Hollywood Beach Cafe — Channel Islands burritos, avocado toast, and morning mimosas steps from the sand

stops.title: DEPART KENTFIELD
stops.subtitle: HEADING SOUTH
stops.description: Head south through the Marin hills, cross the Bay, and pick up I-5 South through the Central Valley — fuel stop at the famed Patterson Starbucks along the way. Los Angeles travelers depart Northridge and head west on US-101.
stops.note: Kentfield: approx. 370 miles · 5 hr 30 min via US-101 and I-5 South

stops.title: DEPART NORTHRIDGE
stops.subtitle: HEADING WEST
stops.description: Head north through the Parking Lot — fuel stop at the famed Harbor Freight Starbucks along the way. Then head west on US-101.
stops.note: Los Angeles: approx. 40 miles · 1 hr via US-101 West

day_2_side.name: Hollywood Beach Cafe
day_2_side.tagline: Beachside diner steps from the sand
day_2_side.description: A local favorite just steps from the water, offering a casual beachside diner vibe perfect for a relaxed morning. Features a full bar for morning mimosas and excellent coffee. Closes at 3:00 PM.

day_2_side.name: See-bee Museum
day_2_side.description: The museum offers a deeply immersive look into a unique branch of military history, combining heavy engineering with combat readiness.

day_2_side.name: Strey Cellars
day_2_side.description: A Ventura County Winery and Tasting Room experience like no other, with a fun and welcoming atmosphere accented by nothing less than great wine!

restaurants_2.name: Mrs. Olson's Restaurant
restaurants_2.description: A staple of the Oxnard harbor area for over fifty years, famous for massive portions, classic harbor-side charm, and panoramic marina views. Hearty American breakfast classics are the draw — enormous omelets, scrambles, and diner favorites. Stays open until 4:00 PM on Saturdays.
